messages.text: What is OFDM, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

OFDM is described here as the waveform/grid basis in which frequency-domain subcarriers and time-domain OFDM symbols form the NR resource grid [2]. An NR Resource Element is one subcarrier in one OFDM symbol on one antenna port [3]. OFDM signals are formed as a linear combination of many QAM symbols through an IFFT, which is why they can have high PAPR [46]. In an OFDM system, a cyclic prefix is added to each time-domain OFDM symbol as a guard interval to reduce inter-symbol interference [5]. In 5G NR, numerology μ defines OFDM time-frequency resolution, including OFDM symbol duration and subcarrier spacing [37].
| Product-related measurement decision | Rohde & Schwarz product facts | Why OFDM understanding matters | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Choose/configure 5G NR FR1 uplink TX measurement capability on R&S CMX500 | R&S CMX-KM600 is necessary for any NR FR1 uplink TX tests; NR FR1 uplink measurements include multi-evaluation, PRACH, SRS and TPC; multi-evaluation supports 3 MHz to 100 MHz channel bandwidth [23]. | NR measurements use an OFDM resource grid of subcarriers and OFDM symbols, and actual allocation, BWP or measurement bandwidth calculations require formal NR specifications [1][2]. | [1][2][23] |
| Choose CMX500 NR analyzer/generator options and interpret EVM-related specs | R&S CMX-KM600 is the 5G NR analyzer option, and R&S CMX-KW601 is the 5G NR generator option [22]. The CMX-KM600 analyzer condition includes FR1, SCS 30 kHz, 16QAM and 100 MHz bandwidth with EVM < 0.5%; the CMX-KW601 generator condition includes 5G NR PDSCH, full allocation, SCS 30 kHz / 60 kHz, 64QAM and 100 MHz bandwidth with EVM < 0.5% [23]. | SCS, OFDM symbol duration, RB allocation and sample rate are OFDM/numerology-dependent NR configuration items [37][39][43]. | [22][23][37][39][43] |
| Decide NR EVM test setup, limits and allocation/modulation conditions | EVM is the difference between a reference waveform and a measured waveform [15]. In the cited 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance test case, the Test ID sets RB Allocation and modulation scheme, EVM must be checked against specified range, and max-power/min-power EVM measurements are required [15]. EVM limits vary by modulation, including Pi/2-BPSK, QPSK, 16QAM, 64QAM and 256QAM [14]. | RBs and REs are defined on the OFDM grid, so allocation-dependent EVM setup requires OFDM grid vocabulary [3][39]. | [3][14][15][39] |
| Choose/configure R&S PVT360A 5G NR downlink/uplink measurement options | R&S PVT-KM320 provides 5G NR downlink measurements release 15/16, R&S PVT-KM321 provides 5G NR uplink measurements release 15/16/17, R&S PVT-KM323 is an uplink multicarrier extension, and R&S PVT-KM325 is an uplink MIMO extension [30][31]. FR1 uplink measurements include multi-evaluation, PRACH, SRS and TPC; NR uplink multi-evaluation supports FDD/TDD, NR standalone, intraband contiguous EN-DC and 3 MHz to 100 MHz channel bandwidth [31]. | These are NR physical-layer measurements over the NR OFDM grid, whose time-frequency resolution is set by numerology and SCS [36][37]. | [30][31][36][37] |
| Decide cyclic prefix / slot-symbol assumptions for NR measurement configuration | Normal CP uses 14 OFDM symbols per slot, while Extended CP uses 12 OFDM symbols per slot; NR Release 15 defines Extended CP only for μ=2 [38]. | CP changes the OFDM symbol/slot structure and therefore affects symbol-level measurement mapping [5][38]. | [5][38] |
| Choose WLAN TX measurement options where OFDM is explicitly part of the test type | R&S PVT360A WLAN measurements include OFDM / DSSS TX tests for power, modulation, spectrum, OBW, spectrum flatness and transmit spectrum mask [28]. PVT WLAN measurement options include R&S PVT-KM410 for 802.11a/b/g/n/p/ac, KM411 for 802.11ax, KM412 for 802.11be, KM413 for WLAN MIMO extension and KM414 for 802.11bn [28][30]. | The cited WLAN test category explicitly includes OFDM TX tests [28]. | [28][30] |
| Choose CMX500 WLAN TX measurement options | CMX500 measurement options include R&S CMX-KM350 for WLAN TX measurements IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, CMX-KM351 for IEEE 802.11ax and CMX-KM352 for IEEE 802.11be [22]. CMX500 features also include WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements covering 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn and 2x2 MIMO [20]. | The passages identify WLAN TX measurement products, but do not directly state which of those CMX500 WLAN options are OFDM-specific. | [20][22] |

【推論】For WLAN product configuration, OFDM understanding is directly relevant to PVT360A WLAN measurements because the source explicitly lists “OFDM / DSSS TX tests”; for CMX500 WLAN options, the passages support WLAN TX measurement capability but do not prove the CMX500 option selection is OFDM-specific [20][22][28][30].
The supplied RAW passages do not add a supported OFDM definition or measurement-option specification; they only show a product brochure pointer and Rohde & Schwarz mobile radio testing contact information [66][67][68].

CMX500 features also include WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements covering 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn and 2x2 MIMO [20]. | The passages identify WLAN TX measurement products, but do not directly state which of those CMX500 WLAN options are OFDM-specific. | [20][22] |
【推論】For NR product configuration, OFDM understanding is needed before choosing or configuring CMX500 KM600/KW601 or PVT360A NR measurement options, because the products are specified by NR measurement type, SCS, bandwidth, allocation or EVM conditions, while NR allocation and measurement bandwidth are defined on the OFDM resource grid and require formal NR specifications for exact calculation [1][2][22][23][30][31][37][39].
【推論】For WLAN product configuration, OFDM understanding is directly relevant to PVT360A WLAN measurements because the source explicitly lists “OFDM / DSSS TX tests”; for CMX500 WLAN options, the passages support WLAN TX measurement capability but do not prove the CMX500 option selection is OFDM-specific [20][22][28][30].
The supplied RAW passages do not add a supported OFDM definition or measurement-option specification; they only show a product brochure pointer and Rohde & Schwarz mobile radio testing contact information [66][67][68].

NR resource grid › 使用限制
- [[NR Frame Structure]] 未提供 full resource grid formalism，例如 common resource blocks、physical resource blocks、virtual resource blocks、BWP 或 ARFCN mapping。
- Point-A 只以概念文字描述；來源未提供 offsetToPointA、absoluteFrequencyPointA 或 RRC ASN.1 定義。
- 若要計算實際 allocation、BWP 或 measurement bandwidth，需查正式 [[3GPP TS 38.211]] / [[3GPP TS 38.214]] / RRC specifications。

NR resource grid
[[NR resource grid]] 是 5G NR 中以 frequency-domain subcarriers 與 time-domain [[OFDM symbol]]s 組成的 resource mapping grid；[[NR Frame Structure]] 在 resource grid 段落定義 [[Resource Element]]、[[Resource Block]] 與 [[Point-A]]。

NR resource grid › Resource Element
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- [[Resource Element]] is the unit of a single subcarrier in one OFDM symbol and on one antenna port。

因此 RE 是 frequency、time 與 antenna port 三個維度上的最小 grid unit。

NR resource grid › 與 CSI-RS / DMRS 的關係
既有 [[3GPP TS 38.211]] 頁面已收錄 [[CSI-RS]] 與 [[Demodulation Reference Signals (DMRS)]] 對 TS 38.211 的引用。這些 reference signal 的 resource mapping 都需要 RE / RB / OFDM symbol 的 grid vocabulary。

本頁只補充 [[NR Frame Structure]] 來源中的 grid 基礎定義，不重述 DMRS 或 CSI-RS mapping tables。

NR cyclic prefix › 基本概念
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- 在 OFDM system 中，CP is added for each OFDM symbol in time-domain。
- CP 是把 raw OFDM symbol 最後幾個 samples 複製到 raw OFDM symbol 前方。
- CP provides a guard interval between two OFDM symbols。
- CP 用於 eliminate inter-symbol interference, ISI。
- NR defines two types of cyclic prefix lengths：[[Normal CP]] 與 [[Extended CP]]。

NR cyclic prefix › Normal CP
[[Normal CP]] 是 normal short length CP：

- 用於 short delay spread environment。
- 14 [[OFDM symbol]]s per slot。
- 來源說 standard CP length of most OFDM symbols is 9/128 × NFFT，approximately 7 percent redundancy overhead。
- CP of the first OFDM symbol of every half-subframe is longer than all others，以 compensate inequality。

來源列出的 NCP 標準 CP duration：

| μ | Raw OFDM symbol duration | Standard CP duration | Long CP duration | Delay spread estimate |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0 | 66.667 μs | 4.6875 μs | 5.2083 μs | 1406 m |
| 1 | 33.333 μs | 2.3438 μs | 2.8646 μs | 703 m |
| 2 | 16.667 μs | 1.1719 μs | 1.6927 μs | 351.6 m |
| 3 | 8.333 μs | 0.5859 μs | 1.1067 μs | 175.8 m |
| 4 | 4.167 μs | 0.2930 μs | 0.8138 μs | 87.9 m |

NR cyclic prefix › Extended CP
[[Extended CP]] 是 extended longer length CP：

- 用於 long delay spread environment。
- 12 [[OFDM symbol]]s per slot。
- CP length is same for all OFDM symbols。
- CP length = NFFT / 4。
- 來源說 this means 25 percent redundancy overhead。
- 來源明示：In NR Release 15 the ECP is only defined for numerology μ=2。

來源列出的 ECP CP duration 線索：

| μ | Raw OFDM symbol duration | CP duration | OFDM symbol incl. CP | Slot duration | Delay spread estimate |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0 | 66.667 μs | 16.667 μs | 83.333 μs | 1000 μs | 5000 m |
| 1 | 33.333 μs | 8.333 μs | 41.667 μs | 500 μs | 2500 m |
| 2 | 16.667 μs | 4.167 μs | 20.833 μs | 250 μs | 1250 m |
| 3 | 8.333 μs | 2.083 μs | 10.417 μs | 125 μs | 625 m |
| 4 | 4.167 μs | 1.042 μs | 5.208 μs | 62.5 μs | 312.5 m |

注意：雖然來源表中列出多個 μ 的 ECP duration，來源同頁明示 NR Release 15 ECP only defined for μ=2；因此不可把表格直接解讀為所有 μ 在 Release 15 均可用。

NR cyclic prefix › 與 samples per slot 的關係
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- Samples per subframe S = NFFT × 15 × 2^μ。
- Samples per slot = samples per subframe / slots per subframe = NFFT × 15。
- Useful samples per slot = NFFT × 14 useful OFDM samples。
- CP 對應的 redundant samples distributed over subframe。

當 14 OFDM symbols per slot 時：

- Redundant samples per subframe = NFFT × 2^μ。
- Each slot has total NFFT redundant samples。

當 12 OFDM symbols per slot 時：

- Redundant samples per subframe = 3 × NFFT × 2^μ。
- Each slot has total 3 × NFFT redundant samples。

NR cyclic prefix
[[NR cyclic prefix]] 是 5G NR OFDM symbol 前方加上的 guard interval；[[NR Frame Structure]] 將其分為 [[Normal CP]] 與 [[Extended CP]]。

CORESET
[[CORESET]]（Control Resource Set）是 5G NR 中 [[PDCCH]] 所在的 time-frequency resource area，由 frequency-domain RB group bitmap 與 time-domain OFDM symbol duration 定義。

CORESET › REG 編號
依 [[PDCCH (NR)]]，[[Resource Element Group (REG)]] within a CORESET are numbered in increasing order in a time-first manner：

- 從 0 開始。
- 第一個 REG 對應 CORESET 的 first [[OFDM symbol]] 與 lowest-numbered [[Resource Block]]。
- CORESET 中的 REG 總數稱為 `NREG`。

CORESET › REG bundle 與 CCE
CORESET 內的 PDCCH resource hierarchy 為：

- [[Resource Element]]。
- [[Resource Element Group (REG)]]：one RB during one OFDM symbol，含 9 data REs 與 3 DMRS REs。
- [[REG bundle]]：L=2、3 或 6 個 consecutively numbered REGs。
- [[Control Channel Element (CCE)]]：6 REGs。
- [[Aggregation Level]]：一個 PDCCH 使用的 CCE 數。

CORESET › 定義
依 [[PDCCH (NR)]]：

- A CORESET is the area in which PDCCHs are located。
- CORESET 的 dimension 由以下參數定義：
  - `frequencyDomainResources`：bitmap，每個 bit 對應 frequency domain 中一組 6 [[Resource Block]]s。
  - `duration`：1、2 或 3 個 contiguous [[OFDM symbol]]s。

因此 CORESET 同時定義 [[PDCCH]] candidate / allocation 可出現的頻率範圍與時間長度。

EVM › 1C111 中的 5G NR EVM limits
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]，EVM measurement results 必須低於 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] Table 6.4.2.1.5-1 的 maximum error percentage，並套用 Table 6.4.2.1.5-2 定義的 Test Tolerance（TT）。來源摘錄的 Average EVM Level limits 為：

| Modulation | Average EVM level limit |
|---|---|
| Pi/2-BPSK | 30 + TT % |
| QPSK | 17.5 + TT % |
| 16 QAM | 12.5 + TT % |
| 64 QAM | 8 + TT % |
| 256 QAM | 3.5 + TT % |

TT 來源摘錄為：

| 條件 | TT |
|---|---|
| All except 256QAM | 0% |
| 256 QAM @ max power | 0.3% |
| 256 QAM @ min power | 1.1% |

來源範例：DUT on n78、100 MHz BW、PUCCH Test ID 1（QPSK）時，specified maximum EVM 為 **17.5 + 0 %**，且 CMX EVM measurement 位於 3GPP limits 內。

EVM › 來源定義
依 [[WIC Glossary]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- EVM 展開為 Error Vector Magnitude。

依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]（06.2025）：

- Error Vector Magnitude（EVM）是 reference waveform 與 measured waveform 之間差異的量測。
- 來源將 EVM 放在 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] test case **6.4.2.1 Error Vector Magnitude PUCCH/PUSCH**。
- Test ID 會設定 RB Allocation 與 modulation scheme。
- PUCCH subtests 需參考 application note chapter 2.1 notes。
- Apply configuration 後，需確認 measured DUT EVM 位於 specified range 內。
- Test case 要求在 DUT max power 與 min power 下量測 EVM。
- CMX 會先自動設定 max power；完成 max power EVM verification 後，DUT 需使用 TPC Closed Loop settings 設定為 min power。

[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 對同一 test case 的定義與限值摘要相同，並支撐既有 EVM 頁面內容。

EVM › 使用限制
- 本頁不是完整 EVM measurement tutorial，也不是 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] 標準全文。
- [[WIC Glossary]] 只提供縮寫展開；[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 與 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 只提供 selected NR-FR1 SA test case 摘要。
- 不可由此頁推論 FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi、LTE、NR 或 production line test 的所有 EVM limits。
- 任何正式 pass / fail limit 應回查對應標準、儀器文件、software version 與 test condition。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

- All other items warranty：1 year。
- Calibration service plans：up to five years；on demand 為 pay per calibration。
- Warranty and repair service plans：up to five years；on demand 為 standard price repair。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › Spectrum analysis
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，R&S CMX-KM140 提供 spectrum analysis options，包含 frequency sweep measurement（power vs frequency）與 zero span measurement（power vs time）。General settings 包含 external attenuation **-50 dB 至 90 dB**、sweep count **1 至 100**、sweep points **101 至 100001**；frequency sweep RBW **100 Hz 至 10 MHz**，VBW **10 Hz 至 10 MHz**。

[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 另提供 FFT spectrum analyzer span 與 FFT length，詳見 ARB 與 FFT spectrum analyzer 章節。

R&S CMX500 › NR FR1
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，R&S CMX-KM600 是 frequency range 1 對 NR uplink signals 執行任何 TX tests 的必要 option。NR FR1 uplink measurements 包含 multi-evaluation、PRACH、SRS、TPC measurement。Multi-evaluation 支援 NR channel bandwidth **3 MHz 到 100 MHz**，可分析 FDD 與 TDD signals、NR standalone signals 與 intraband contiguous EN-DC signals。

依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，R&S CMX-KM600 option 的 5G NR analyzer 條件為 FR1、SCS 30 kHz、16QAM、temperature range +15 °C to +35 °C；input level –25 dBm to –10 dBm RMS、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。Frequency measurement uncertainty：**< 20 Hz + drift of timebase**；相對於同一台 CMX500 device 的 downlink signal 進行 frequency error measurements 時，uncertainty 符合 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] V18.5.0。

R&S CMX-KW601 option 的 5G NR generator 條件：5G NR PDSCH、full allocation、SCS 30 kHz / 60 kHz、modulation 64QAM、PAR 11.8 dB、temperature +15 °C to +35 °C；ports RF Com 1、RF Com 2、RF Out 1 to RF Out 4；output level –5 dBm、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S PVT360A
[[R&S PVT360A]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Performance Vector Tester**，依 [[PVT360A_Features_V8-5-30_en_06]] Version 06 可透過 R&S PVT-KW / KM / KB options 提供多無線標準 waveform playback、TX/RX measurements、spectrum analysis、WLAN MIMO 與 external frontend frequency extension。

NR sample rate › Sample rate 公式
來源給出的 NR sample rate calculation：

- Sampling rate in samples/sec = number of samples per raw OFDM symbol / duration of one raw OFDM symbol。
- Sampling rate = NFFT / (1 / SCS)。
- Sampling rate = NFFT × SCS。
- SCS = 2^μ × 15 kHz。
- 因此 sampling rate = NFFT × 2^μ × 15 kHz。

NR sample rate
[[NR sample rate]] 是 5G NR OFDM waveform 中由 NFFT 與 [[Subcarrier Spacing]] 決定的 sampling rate；[[NR Frame Structure]] 以 [[3GPP TS 38.211]] chapter 4.1 的 Tc 定義為起點說明。

Low-PAPR sequence › Transform precoding 與 π/2-BPSK
依 [[DMRS]]：

- [[DFT-s-OFDM]] 也稱為 [[Transform precoding]]，在 LTE 與 NR 的 UL 中啟用，用於取得 low-PAPR UL transmit signal。
- Transform precoding 中 modulation symbols 先經 DFT-precoded，再輸入 OFDM modulator。
- DFT 與 OFDM modulator 的 IFFT block effectively cancels one another，因此移除 OFDM modulator 的 high-PAPR effect。
- 使用 low-PAPR modulation symbols 可進一步降低 UL transmit signal 的 PAPR。
- NR 中 UL transmission with transform precoding 啟用 [[π-2-BPSK]] modulation。
- [[π-2-BPSK]] 產生 low-PAPR waveform，因為 symbol-to-symbol transition 不會穿越 constellation 的 zero-amplitude point。

Low-PAPR sequence › 背景：為什麼需要 low-PAPR
依 [[DMRS]]：

- OFDM signals 具有 high peak-to-average power ratio（PAPR），因為由 many random QAM symbols 的 linear combination（IFFT）形成。
- High-PAPR signal 需要 transmitter back-off power amplifier operating point，以避免 transmit signal 進入 power amplifier saturation region 而 clipped / distorted。
- Power amplifier 遠離 saturation point 操作時 efficiency drops。
- DL signals 由連接 power grid 的 base station 傳送，因此 high-PAPR 在 DL 不 critical；NR uses OFDM for DL signals。
- NR 與 LTE 不同，NR UL 也允許使用 OFDM signals。
- UL 可能需要 low-PAPR signal，使 [[UE]] power amplifier 更接近 saturation point 並提升 efficiency，降低 UE battery energy 消耗。

Low-PAPR sequence › Type 1（Release 15）
依 [[DMRS]]：

- [[Low-PAPR sequence Type 1]] 屬 [[Release 15]]。
- 使用 [[Zadoff-Chu sequence]] 或 computer-generated sequences；reference：[[3GPP TS 38.211]] Section 5.2.2。
- 用於 transform precoding enabled 時的 PUSCH DMRS sequences，且 Type 2 的條件不成立時。
- 也用於 PUCCH format 1 的 DMRS sequences，以及 PUCCH formats 3 and 4 的 DMRS sequences。
- Small sequences：1 to 5 PRBs，使用 computer-generated 或 Zadoff-Chu sequences。
- Large sequence：more than 5 PRBs，使用 Zadoff-Chu sequences。
- Zadoff-Chu sequences based on length `N_ZC_RS`，其中 `N_ZC_RS` 是小於 `M_ZC_RS` 的最大 prime number。
- 第 `N_ZC_RS` 個 sample 之後，sequence 從 beginning repeat。
- Sequences depend on group number only，not on `n_ID`。

Low-PAPR sequence › Type 2（Release 16）
依 [[DMRS]]：

- [[Low-PAPR sequence Type 2]] 屬 [[Release 16]]。
- [[3GPP TS 38.211]] Section 5.2.3 定義新的 low-PAPR sequences：`low-PAPR Type 2`。
- Type 2 使用 pseudo-noise 或 computer-generated sequences。
- `n_ID` is not effective。
- 用於 transform precoding enabled 時的 PUSCH DMRS sequences，且以下條件全部成立：
  - PUSCH modulated with [[π-2-BPSK]]。
  - PUSCH transmission is not a `msg3` transmission。
  - Scheduling is not using `DCI format 0_0` in a common search space。
- Type 2 low-PAPR sequence generated from the DFT of the [[π-2-BPSK]] modulated computer generated sequences（CGS）or gold sequences。
- DFT operation may cause some sequence samples to be zero，因此 channel estimation 需要 special handling。
- Small sequences：1 to 4 PRBs，使用 computer-generated sequences。
- 有些 sequences 由 [[3GPP TS 38.211]] Tables 5.2.3.2-2 to 5.2.3.2-4 定義的 computer-generated binary sequences，並以 [[π-2-BPSK]] modulated。
- Sequences depend on sequence length and group number only，not on `n_ID`。

OFDM is described here as the waveform/grid basis in which frequency-domain subcarriers and time-domain OFDM symbols form the NR resource grid [2]. An NR Resource Element is one subcarrier in one OFDM symbol on one antenna port [3]. OFDM signals are formed as a linear combination of many QAM symbols through an IFFT, which is why they can have high PAPR [46]. In an OFDM system, a cyclic prefix is added to each time-domain OFDM symbol as a guard interval to reduce inter-symbol interference [5]. In 5G NR, numerology μ defines OFDM time-frequency resolution, including OFDM symbol duration and subcarrier spacing [37].
| Product-related measurement decision | Rohde & Schwarz product facts | Why OFDM understanding matters | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Choose/configure 5G NR FR1 uplink TX measurement capability on R&S CMX500 | R&S CMX-KM600 is necessary for any NR FR1 uplink TX tests; NR FR1 uplink measurements include multi-evaluation, PRACH, SRS and TPC; multi-evaluation supports 3 MHz to 100 MHz channel bandwidth [23]. | NR measurements use an OFDM resource grid of subcarriers and OFDM symbols, and actual allocation, BWP or measurement bandwidth calculations require formal NR specifications [1][2]. | [1][2][23] |
| Choose CMX500 NR analyzer/generator options and interpret EVM-related specs | R&S CMX-KM600 is the 5G NR analyzer option, and R&S CMX-KW601 is the 5G NR generator option [22]. The CMX-KM600 analyzer condition includes FR1, SCS 30 kHz, 16QAM and 100 MHz bandwidth with EVM < 0.5%; the CMX-KW601 generator condition includes 5G NR PDSCH, full allocation, SCS 30 kHz / 60 kHz, 64QAM and 100 MHz bandwidth with EVM < 0.5% [23]. | SCS, OFDM symbol duration, RB allocation and sample rate are OFDM/numerology-dependent NR configuration items [37][39][43]. | [22][23][37][39][43] |
| Decide NR EVM test setup, limits and allocation/modulation conditions | EVM is the difference between a reference waveform and a measured waveform [15]. In the cited 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance test case, the Test ID sets RB Allocation and modulation scheme, EVM must be checked against specified range, and max-power/min-power EVM measurements are required [15]. EVM limits vary by modulation, including Pi/2-BPSK, QPSK, 16QAM, 64QAM and 256QAM [14]. | RBs and REs are defined on the OFDM grid, so allocation-dependent EVM setup requires OFDM grid vocabulary [3][39]. | [3][14][15][39] |
| Choose/configure R&S PVT360A 5G NR downlink/uplink measurement options | R&S PVT-KM320 provides 5G NR downlink measurements release 15/16, R&S PVT-KM321 provides 5G NR uplink measurements release 15/16/17, R&S PVT-KM323 is an uplink multicarrier extension, and R&S PVT-KM325 is an uplink MIMO extension [30][31]. FR1 uplink measurements include multi-evaluation, PRACH, SRS and TPC; NR uplink multi-evaluation supports FDD/TDD, NR standalone, intraband contiguous EN-DC and 3 MHz to 100 MHz channel bandwidth [31]. | These are NR physical-layer measurements over the NR OFDM grid, whose time-frequency resolution is set by numerology and SCS [36][37]. | [30][31][36][37] |
| Decide cyclic prefix / slot-symbol assumptions for NR measurement configuration | Normal CP uses 14 OFDM symbols per slot, while Extended CP uses 12 OFDM symbols per slot; NR Release 15 defines Extended CP only for μ=2 [38]. | CP changes the OFDM symbol/slot structure and therefore affects symbol-level measurement mapping [5][38]. | [5][38] |
| Choose WLAN TX measurement options where OFDM is explicitly part of the test type | R&S PVT360A WLAN measurements include OFDM / DSSS TX tests for power, modulation, spectrum, OBW, spectrum flatness and transmit spectrum mask [28]. PVT WLAN measurement options include R&S PVT-KM410 for 802.11a/b/g/n/p/ac, KM411 for 802.11ax, KM412 for 802.11be, KM413 for WLAN MIMO extension and KM414 for 802.11bn [28][30]. | The cited WLAN test category explicitly includes OFDM TX tests [28]. | [28][30] |

CMX500 features also include WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements covering 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn and 2x2 MIMO [20]. | The passages identify WLAN TX measurement products, but do not directly state which of those CMX500 WLAN options are OFDM-specific. | [20][22] |
【推論】For NR product configuration, OFDM understanding is needed before choosing or configuring CMX500 KM600/KW601 or PVT360A NR measurement options, because the products are specified by NR measurement type, SCS, bandwidth, allocation or EVM conditions, while NR allocation and measurement bandwidth are defined on the OFDM resource grid and require formal NR specifications for exact calculation [1][2][22][23][30][31][37][39].
【推論】For WLAN product configuration, OFDM understanding is directly relevant to PVT360A WLAN measurements because the source explicitly lists “OFDM / DSSS TX tests”; for CMX500 WLAN options, the passages support WLAN TX measurement capability but do not prove the CMX500 option selection is OFDM-specific [20][22][28][30].

NR resource grid › 使用限制
- [[NR Frame Structure]] 未提供 full resource grid formalism，例如 common resource blocks、physical resource blocks、virtual resource blocks、BWP 或 ARFCN mapping。
- Point-A 只以概念文字描述；來源未提供 offsetToPointA、absoluteFrequencyPointA 或 RRC ASN.1 定義。
- 若要計算實際 allocation、BWP 或 measurement bandwidth，需查正式 [[3GPP TS 38.211]] / [[3GPP TS 38.214]] / RRC specifications。

NR resource grid
[[NR resource grid]] 是 5G NR 中以 frequency-domain subcarriers 與 time-domain [[OFDM symbol]]s 組成的 resource mapping grid；[[NR Frame Structure]] 在 resource grid 段落定義 [[Resource Element]]、[[Resource Block]] 與 [[Point-A]]。

NR resource grid › Resource Element
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- [[Resource Element]] is the unit of a single subcarrier in one OFDM symbol and on one antenna port。

因此 RE 是 frequency、time 與 antenna port 三個維度上的最小 grid unit。

NR cyclic prefix › 基本概念
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- 在 OFDM system 中，CP is added for each OFDM symbol in time-domain。
- CP 是把 raw OFDM symbol 最後幾個 samples 複製到 raw OFDM symbol 前方。
- CP provides a guard interval between two OFDM symbols。
- CP 用於 eliminate inter-symbol interference, ISI。
- NR defines two types of cyclic prefix lengths：[[Normal CP]] 與 [[Extended CP]]。

EVM › 1C111 中的 5G NR EVM limits
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]，EVM measurement results 必須低於 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] Table 6.4.2.1.5-1 的 maximum error percentage，並套用 Table 6.4.2.1.5-2 定義的 Test Tolerance（TT）。來源摘錄的 Average EVM Level limits 為：

| Modulation | Average EVM level limit |
|---|---|
| Pi/2-BPSK | 30 + TT % |
| QPSK | 17.5 + TT % |
| 16 QAM | 12.5 + TT % |
| 64 QAM | 8 + TT % |
| 256 QAM | 3.5 + TT % |

TT 來源摘錄為：

| 條件 | TT |
|---|---|
| All except 256QAM | 0% |
| 256 QAM @ max power | 0.3% |
| 256 QAM @ min power | 1.1% |

來源範例：DUT on n78、100 MHz BW、PUCCH Test ID 1（QPSK）時，specified maximum EVM 為 **17.5 + 0 %**，且 CMX EVM measurement 位於 3GPP limits 內。

EVM › 來源定義
依 [[WIC Glossary]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- EVM 展開為 Error Vector Magnitude。

依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]（06.2025）：

- Error Vector Magnitude（EVM）是 reference waveform 與 measured waveform 之間差異的量測。
- 來源將 EVM 放在 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] test case **6.4.2.1 Error Vector Magnitude PUCCH/PUSCH**。
- Test ID 會設定 RB Allocation 與 modulation scheme。
- PUCCH subtests 需參考 application note chapter 2.1 notes。
- Apply configuration 後，需確認 measured DUT EVM 位於 specified range 內。
- Test case 要求在 DUT max power 與 min power 下量測 EVM。
- CMX 會先自動設定 max power；完成 max power EVM verification 後，DUT 需使用 TPC Closed Loop settings 設定為 min power。

[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 對同一 test case 的定義與限值摘要相同，並支撐既有 EVM 頁面內容。

Uplink CA 支援 number of carriers **1 to 2**；two TX antennas measurement 可提供 per layer、per antenna 或 sum of antennas 的結果，依 measurement result 類型而定。

5G NR numerology
[[5G NR numerology]] 是 5G NR 中以 μ 表示的 OFDM time-frequency resolution 參數，決定 [[Subcarrier Spacing]]、slot duration、subframe 中 slots 數量，以及 [[SSB]] required bandwidth。

5G NR numerology › 定義
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- Numerology μ defines the time-frequency resolution。
- μ 決定 [[OFDM symbol]] time duration 與 [[Subcarrier Spacing]]。
- NR reference SCS μ=0 是 15 kHz，來源說與 LTE 相同。
- μ 越高，time resolution 越高。
- μ 越高，frequency resolution 越低。

5G NR frame structure › OFDM symbols per slot
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- [[Normal CP]] 使用 14 [[OFDM symbol]]s per slot。
- [[Extended CP]] 使用 12 [[OFDM symbol]]s per slot。
- 來源明示在 NR Release 15 中，[[Extended CP]] only defined for numerology μ=2。

5G NR frame structure › 與 resource grid 的關係
Frame / subframe / slot / symbol 是 time-domain structure；[[NR resource grid]] 則把 time-domain [[OFDM symbol]] 與 frequency-domain subcarriers 組成 grid。

- [[Resource Element]] 是 one subcarrier in one OFDM symbol and on one antenna port。
- [[Resource Block]] 是 12 consecutive subcarriers。
- [[Point-A]] 是 resource grid starts toward higher frequencies 的 frequency-domain reference。

NR sample rate › Sample rate 公式
來源給出的 NR sample rate calculation：

- Sampling rate in samples/sec = number of samples per raw OFDM symbol / duration of one raw OFDM symbol。
- Sampling rate = NFFT / (1 / SCS)。
- Sampling rate = NFFT × SCS。
- SCS = 2^μ × 15 kHz。
- 因此 sampling rate = NFFT × 2^μ × 15 kHz。

Low-PAPR sequence › 背景：為什麼需要 low-PAPR
依 [[DMRS]]：

- OFDM signals 具有 high peak-to-average power ratio（PAPR），因為由 many random QAM symbols 的 linear combination（IFFT）形成。
- High-PAPR signal 需要 transmitter back-off power amplifier operating point，以避免 transmit signal 進入 power amplifier saturation region 而 clipped / distorted。
- Power amplifier 遠離 saturation point 操作時 efficiency drops。
- DL signals 由連接 power grid 的 base station 傳送，因此 high-PAPR 在 DL 不 critical；NR uses OFDM for DL signals。
- NR 與 LTE 不同，NR UL 也允許使用 OFDM signals。
- UL 可能需要 low-PAPR signal，使 [[UE]] power amplifier 更接近 saturation point 並提升 efficiency，降低 UE battery energy 消耗。
